notes.title: Update to Hexa
notes.notes:
- Added a pause menu and burger menu to open it
- Added localization through the Steam Workshop
- Added a settings menu with ability to change resolution, full screen and toggle sound
- Menu layout slightly changed. Level Editor and ability to upload to the workshop moved to a Tools sub-menu
- Fixed a bug with converters which affected levels 14 and 23
- Slightly changed level 33

notes.title: Latest Update - New Hexside Added!
notes.notes:
Hexa just got a new update added a Switch Hexside. This hexside will only allow projectiles through if the switch is receiving projectiles of the requested type.

There has also been a few other changes:
[list]
[*] Can now chose which hexsides appear in the random levels
[*] Fixed a few bugs happening in the random levels
[*] Level 9 tweaked slightly
[*] Projectiles now dissolve when at end of life
[*] Level's now save in a new format. This creates smaller save files and will be easier for me to create new hexsides. Unfortunately this means that any levels create prior to this patch will no longer be compatible. If you want your old levels converted send me a email at support@salusgames.com and I will convert them and send them back to you.
[/list]

notes.title: 19/05/19 Patch
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added instructions on how to pan the camera, restart level and quit to main menu
[*] Indicator on the level select screen if the level has been solved
[*] WASD keys no longer tab through the button in the level editor.
[*] Added ability to restart a level (R key)
[*] Camera panning speed increased
[*] Options to customize random level (More options to be added)
[*] Zoom option in Level Editor
[*] Fixed the Move tool in the Level Editor created a empty Hex
[*] Improved color picker in the Level Editor
[*] Can't upload level to the workshop if its not been tested and completed.
[*] Fixed the camera moving in the level editor when a popup is open
[/list]
